title: Bechtel job fair near Syracuse attracts hundreds as hiring ramps up for Micron construction
summary: Bechtel held a major hiring event in DeWitt attracting 500 job seekers for construction positions on Micron Technology's chipmaking facility in Clay. The job fair signals significant workforce mobilization for a major regional infrastructure project with potential implications for local economic development and labor markets.

political_signal.description: Large-scale private sector job creation event demonstrates regional economic momentum around major semiconductor manufacturing investment, aligning with municipal economic development priorities.
